
### connections 

![](/network/texfig/connection-model.figure.svg){fig-alt="A calls Connect(Conn, B) and messages are sent to be to start a connection. B calls Accept() and gets its own Conn object and messages are sent to verify connection is made. Then, A calls Send(Conn, '2 + 2 = ?') and B calls Recv(Conn) which returns '2 + 2 = ?'. Then B calls Send(Conn, '4') and A calls Recv(Conn) which returns '4'."}


### connection abstraction

*  most common version: (BSD) "sockets":
*  setup:
   *  passive end ("server"): listen() + accept()
   *  active end ("client"): connect()
*  program at each end has file descriptor representing connection
*  usage after setup: send() + recv()
